_about: Which linked records each kind of page SHOWS. Links always stay two-way in the data: hiding a kind here only stops it being displayed on that page – the other page still lists this one. Example: an event linked to the University of Liverpool appears on Liverpool's page, but Liverpool is not listed on the event. Per record, add display.hide (e.g. ["members"] or ["members/university-of-liverpool"]) or display.show (e.g. ["members/university-of-liverpool"]) to override.
